claims.verbatim:
The Brazilian, from New York; the Worcester, from
Baltimore, and the Propontis, from Philadelphia, arrived
at Liverpool June 25.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 12 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Helvetia (Br), Ogilvie, Liverpool May 29, with
mdse and 757 passengers, to the National Steamship Co.
May 30, in the Channel, passed steamship Kangoroo; 31st,
lat 51, lon 15, steamship Pennsylvania; June 3, lat 47 50, lon
32 26, steamship Virginia—all hence for Liverpool; 4th, lat 46,
lon 38 28, bark W H Jenkins, bound W; 6th, lat 43 17, lon 47
12, a bark rigged steamer bound E; 7th, lat 41 49, lon 53 18,
steamship Britannia, hence for Glasgow; 10th, lat 40 32, lon
70 40, steamships Fulton, City of London, Teutonia, and
Brazilian, bound E.
